mapper.select: SELECT ft.tag_id AS tagId, f.name AS name, f.address AS address, f.floor AS floor, f.zone AS zone, f.facility_id AS facilityId FROM facility_tags ft JOIN facilities f ON f.facility_id = ft.facility_id WHERE ft.tag_id = #{tagId} AND ft.active = 'Y' AND ft.revoked_at IS NULL

SELECT SUBSTR(REGEXP_REPLACE(ip.phone,'[^0-9]',''), -4) AS phone_last4 FROM facility_tags ft JOIN facilities f ON f.facility_id = ft.facility_id JOIN inspector_profile ip ON ip.inspector_id = f.inspector_id WHERE ft.tag_id = #{tagId} AND ft.active = 'Y' AND ft.revoked_at IS NULL FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT ct.template_id AS templateId, ct.domain AS domain, ct.name AS name, ct.cycle AS cycle, ct.cycle_unit AS cycleUnit, ct.version AS version, ct.is_active AS isActive, ct.created_at AS createdAt, ct.facility_id AS facilityId FROM facility_tags ft JOIN facilities f ON ft.facility_id = f.facility_id JOIN checklist_templates ct ON ct.facility_id = f.facility_id WHERE ft.tag_id = #{tagId} AND ft.active = 'Y' AND ft.revoked_at IS NULL AND ct.is_active = 'Y' ORDER BY ct.version DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT ci.item_id AS itemId, ci.order_no AS orderNo, ci.label AS label, ci.type AS type, CASE WHEN ci.required = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS required, ci.note AS note, ci.guideline AS guide, ci.template_id AS templateId FROM checklist_items ci WHERE ci.template_id = #{templateId} ORDER BY ci.order_no

SELECT f.facility_id AS facilityId, f.inspector_id AS inspectorId FROM facility_tags ft JOIN facilities f ON f.facility_id = ft.facility_id WHERE ft.tag_id = #{tagId} AND ft.active = 'Y' AND ft.revoked_at IS NULL FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT INSPECTION_ITEM_RESULTS_SEQ.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO inspection_item_results ( result_id, value_bool, value_num, value_text, created_at, item_id, inspection_id ) VALUES ( #{resultId}, #{valueBool, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{valueNum, jdbcType=FLOAT}, #{valueText, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{createdAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{itemId}, #{inspectionId} )
mapper.select: SELECT image_id AS imageId, file_path AS filePath, mime_type AS MimeType, result_id AS resultId FROM images WHERE image_id = #{imageId}
SELECT image_id AS imageId, file_path AS filePath, mime_type AS mimeType, result_id AS resultId FROM images ORDER BY image_id DESC FETCH FIRST ${limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT managers_id FROM facilities WHERE facility_id = #{facilityId} FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert:
SELECT CITIZEN_REPORTS_SEQ.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO citizen_reports ( citizen_report_id, facility_id, category, description, email, status, created_at, resolved_by, resolved_at ) VALUES ( #{citizenReportId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{facilityId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{category, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{description, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{email, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'PENDING', SYSTIMESTAMP, #{resolvedBy, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, NULL )
mapper.update: UPDATE facilities SET next_scheduled_at = CASE WHEN #{cycleUnit} = 'DAY' THEN (SYSTIMESTAMP + #{cycle}) WHEN #{cycleUnit} = 'WEEK' THEN (SYSTIMESTAMP + (7 * #{cycle})) WHEN #{cycleUnit} = 'MONTH' THEN ADD_MONTHS(SYSTIMESTAMP, #{cycle}) WHEN #{cycleUnit} = 'YEAR' THEN ADD_MONTHS(SYSTIMESTAMP, 12 * #{cycle}) ELSE next_scheduled_at END WHERE facility_id = #{facilityId}
mapper.select: SELECT f.gps_lat AS gpsLat, f.gps_lng AS gpsLng FROM facility_tags ft JOIN facilities f ON f.facility_id = ft.facility_id WHERE ft.tag_id = #{tagId} AND ft.active = 'Y' AND ft.revoked_at IS NULL FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
